shortDescription: Manages volume snapshot policies on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the volume is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: device_id
options.description: ID of the device on a VM the volume is attached to. This will only be considered if VM has multiple DATADISK volumes.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the volume is related to.

options.name: interval_type
options.description: Interval of the snapshot.

options.name: max_snaps
options.description: Max number of snapshots.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the volume is related to.

options.name: schedule
options.description: Time the snapshot is scheduled. Required if I(state=present). Format for I(interval_type=HOURLY): C(MM) Format for I(interval_type=DAILY): C(MM:HH) Format for I(interval_type=WEEKLY): C(MM:HH:DD (1-7)) Format for I(interval_type=MONTHLY): C(MM:HH:DD (1-28))

options.name: state
options.description: State of the snapshot policy.

options.name: time_zone
options.description: Specifies a timezone for this command.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vm
options.description: Name of the VM/instance to select the volume from. Use I(volume_type) if VM has a DATADISK and ROOT volume. In case of I(volume_type=DATADISK), additionally use I(device_id) if VM has more than one DATADISK volume. Either I(volume) or I(vm) is required.

options.name: volume
options.description: Name of the volume. Either I(volume) or I(vm) is required.

options.name: volume_type
options.description: Type of the volume.

options.name: vpc
options.description: Name of the vpc the instance is deployed in.
